title: Hostage Run
description: A survival hunt where a Hostage must outlast the timer while Captors battle each other for the killing blow.
body:
# HOSTAGE RUN
Hostage Run is a fun mod to play with friends. At least **2 players** are required: one Hostage and one/more Captor.

# 🎮 The Goal
**The Hostage:** Must **stay alive** until the timer ends (Default: **2.5 hours**)

**The Captors:** Must **kill** the **Hostage by pushing them into the End Void** before the timer ends
- However, only the Captor who delivers the **final hit** wins (so there can only be **1 winner**)
- So Captors must fight each other to be the last one to hit the Hostage

# 💪 Hostage Perks
- Hostage **cannot take/deal damage** to Captors (Only way to kill the Hostage is via the End Void. Also, since Hostage can't take knockback, the Captor can drag them along into the End Void.)
- Hostage escapes if the Captor logs out, dies, or switches dimensions

# 🔗 Captor Items
Captors are given 2 items at the start of the run.

**Hostage Leash item:** Allows Captors to right-click and leash the Hostage
- Can also **tie** the Hostage **onto a fence**
- *The Hostage **cannot DIRECTLY break** the fence.*

**Hostage Tracker Item:** Allows Captors to right-click and track the Hostage's current location
- It does **NOT update automatically** (**Cooldown**: 1 minute)
- **Glows** the Hostage for 5 seconds

# 🎲 Custom Mechanics
**Pickpocket:** Allows Hostage to steal a random item from Captor's Inventory (**50% chance**) (**Cooldown**: 3 minutes)
- If they **sneak for 5 seconds** within **within 1.5 blocks** of them
- **Fails if Captor looks** at Hostage
- A **warning sound** is produced  3 seconds in

**Intimidating:** The longer a Captor has leashed the Hostage, the more buffs he gets
- Buffs stack/stay **even if tied on fence**
- Buffs get cleared if unleashed/untied from that Captor
- Effects:
  - 5 minutes in: Speed 1
  - 10 minutes in: Strength 1
  - 20 minutes in: Resistance 2
  - 30 minutes in: Hostage's Inventory gets cleared (only once)

# 🤖 Commands
To start a Run: **/hostagerun start <Optional: Time_In_Minutes>**
- Default time is **150 minutes** (2.5 hours)

To end a Run: **/hostagerun end**

To set the Hostage: **/hostagerun hostage <Name>**

To add a Captor: **/hostagerun captors add <Name>**

To remove a Captor: **/hostagerun captors remove <Name>**
